raw_response:
The issuer exhibits significant financial weaknesses, including a current ratio of 0.90 (below 1), indicating poor short-term liquidity and an inability to cover current liabilities with current assets. Additionally, the debt-to-equity ratio is approximately 4.17 (89,110M / 21,383M), reflecting very high leverage, while the operating margin of 16.5% (3,213M / 19,443M) is moderate but insufficient to offset these risks. These factors collectively point to high credit risk, placing the issuer in the speculative grade range, specifically B-, due to the severe liquidity and leverage issues.

DECISION: B-
